The role supports the reliability, security, scalability and maintainability of AJ Bell’s infrastructure services, while supporting and enabling the business to achieve its regulatory requirements, including Consumer Duty. Strong understanding of dependencies between infrastructure technologies, applications, networks, identity, security and operational processes. Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and support timely incident and problem resolution. Experience producing technical documentation, implementation plans, support handover material and standards documentation. Experience working within change control, operational governance and service management processes. Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks, decisions and trade-offs clearly. Ability to coach, guide and support less experienced engineers. Storage, backup and disaster recovery technologies, including SAN/NAS, replication, snapshotting and recovery testing concepts. Identity and access technologies such as Active Directory, ADFS, SSO and MFA. Cisco networking technologies, Cisco ISE and Catalyst Centre or equivalent demonstrable networking experience. Partnering closely with Construction, Operations, and Engineering teams, this role delivers fault-tolerant network, compute, and virtualization solutions for new builds and existing sites, ensuring every facility comes online on time, on budget, and to Vantage's standards for reliability, security, and performance. Design, implement, and maintain fault-tolerant, highly available IT networks leveraging Cisco, Fortinet, and Arista platforms, including routing, switching, firewalls, segmentation, and software-defined networking (SDN) leaf-spine fabrics. Architect, build, and harden virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere/ESXi) along with Windows and Linux server environments to support mission-critical workloads. Coordinate with Construction Project Managers and General Contractors to maintain schedule commitments, communicate progress, and resolve site readiness blockers. Manage multiple concurrent one-time and ongoing projects, balancing competing priorities while meeting quality, cost, and schedule targets. Respond to safety, security, and emergency situations; uphold a safe, secure, and compliant work environment at all times. Apply sound judgment to organize workflow, adapt to shifting priorities, and make informed decisions in a dynamic operational environment. Engage frequently with employees at all levels of the organization, as well as external vendors, partners, and customers, to drive aligned outcomes. Duties Provide professional mentorship and specialist advice to the business on systems and project matters, ensuring projects are initiated accurately and appropriate levels of governance are applied throughout the lifecycle. Collaborate with internal partners and stakeholders to design and deliver technology solutions that align with project objectives, operational standards, and customer requirements. Develop business cases, whole-life cost analyses, and feasibility proposals that frame investment vs. risk and align with business objectives. Drive projects to stay within budget and schedule, identifying and planning the effective use of internal and external resources. Manage incidents, problems, software defects, and change requests through ITIL-aligned processes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder communication. Identify opportunities to evolve systems to meet business requirements, leveraging existing platform functionality or new development where appropriate. Support the Senior Manager and Lead Engineer, Information Technology, in delivering services essential to the success of the business and the reliability of customer-facing operations. Handle additional duties as assigned by Management. Demonstrated technical proficiency across Windows Server and Desktop, Active Directory, VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft 365, Cisco, Fortinet, and Arista networking and firewalls, Arista EOS and software-defined networking (SDN), enterprise storage and backup technologies, and end-to-end LAN/WAN networking. Working knowledge of ITIL processes (incident, problem, and change management) and experience operating within structured IT service management frameworks. Hands-on experience deploying IT services to new construction sites, including coordination with general contractors, low-voltage vendors, and commissioning teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear documentation and present technical content to non-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage competing priorities, and deliver under tight deadlines. May be required to complete formal training or certification in an area of specialization. Available to support after-hours maintenance windows, on-call rotations, and emergency response as required by operational demands. Must possess reliable transportation to report to work for scheduled shifts and emergency callouts. If you're interested, we encourage you to apply soon—we’re excited to find the right person and will keep the role open until we do!
